label: boots
js: JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, title: document.title, scripts: document.querySelectorAll('script[src]').length })

label: real frames run the demo
js: new Promise(r => { const a = game.world().t; setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ ran: +(game.world().t - a).toFixed(2), phase: game.state().phase })), 1500); })

label: ? panel freezes the game
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', go: true }); return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { Kit.help.open(); const t0 = game.world().t; setTimeout(() => { const t1 = game.world().t; Kit.help.close(); setTimeout(() => r(JSON.stringify({ frozenFor: '1.2 s', ticksWhileOpen: Math.round((t1 - t0) * 60), runsAfter: game.world().t > t1 })), 600); }, 1200); }, 500)); })()

label: sounds counted while muted
js: (() => { game.quiet(); game.put(0, 2, 2); game.setWin(0, 3, 2, 'open'); const k = (c, d) => dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent(d ? 'keydown' : 'keyup', { code: c })); k('ArrowUp', 1); game.step(0.8); k('ArrowUp', 0); game.call(); game.step(1.5); const s = game.state(); return JSON.stringify({ muted: s.muted, sfx: s.sfx }); })()

label: draw calls
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 2, go: true }); game.step(1); const a = game.info(); game.start({ players: 1, go: true }); game.step(1); return JSON.stringify({ twoPlayers: a, onePlayer: game.info() }); })()

label: playCheck
js: (() => { const r = game.playCheck(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, total: r.total, failed: r.failed }); })()

label: headless check
js: (() => { const r = game.check(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r.ok, n: r.results.length, failed: r.failed }); })()
